scope: User-authorized digital candidate engineering; nothing purchased or powered

items.problem: Full V30 module with local leads remains in collision in all 18 tested Rz90 poses; current V36 PCBA not yet bound to this geometry
items.action: Bind current V36 MAIN board, terminals, Q201, shunt, copper keepouts and mounting holes; keep their electrically important relative positions. Treat long local pigtails and guides as separate routing items, then redesign carrier supports and thermal interfaces around actual host obstacles.
items.acceptance: Source-bound updated PCBA envelope, zero unapproved static intersections in three poses, insertion and termination access, explicit heat path and grounding/insulation, updated native and BOM deltas
do_not_inherit: V30 geometry as V36 electrical qualification

items.problem: PCB bottom at z=-1.5mm and TIM top at z=-6.0mm leave a 4.5mm gap
items.action: Define real board power and temperature limits, grounding/isolation requirement, and a supported conductive path through posts, heat straps or a dedicated part. Re-evaluate thermal contact area removed by the four support clearances.
items.acceptance: Actual contact interfaces in CAD, thermal/material parameters with sources or UNKNOWN, heat analysis and electrical isolation checks; no replacement of missing inputs by zero

items.action: Bind actual cable construction, pinout, mating connectors, bend limits, service loops, shielding/ground termination, clamps and separate physical power/data routes to existing functional topology.
items.acceptance: Manufacturing lengths, termination BOM, access and full-motion sweep verified against tolerances; existing power/AUX/STOP domains preserved

items.action: Select material grades and fastener MPNs, define preload and thread engagement, apply traceable native materials, remove double counting of proxies when replacing them with selected hardware, then recompute whole mass/COM/inertia.
items.acceptance: Material/BOM/native identity reconciliation plus tolerance, insertion, vibration and thermal deformation checks; separate ground and flight readiness decisions
